description: Create a design, either from a whole `document` you supply or by copying an existing design named by `fromDesignId`. Copying is usually right: a document's `catalogPin` must match a catalog revision this server serves, and a copy carries one that does. A `document` whose `home` is an existing design on this server is refused with a `compose-preview-decision/v1` choice to put to the person — or, when your client supports form elicitation on this connection, the person is asked in a form and the call acts on their answer.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

designId.description: The id for the new design.

includeCatalog.description: Embed the pinned catalog in the returned snapshot. Defaults to false.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

visibility.description: Defaults to the server's configured visibility, which is private unless the operator chose public. Public allows anyone with the link to view; editing still requires explicit access.

name: ui_builder_create_design
